gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Offside spaces its letters wide and leaves its curves stubbornly unclosed, a display voice that never lifts its tone. Noto Sans Limbu follows with tall small letters and gaping bowls, easygoing underneath.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Stiff, rod-like and wide-spaced, that's Offside, with arcs that look like bent dowels. And Noto Sans Lisu carries a text that stays easy to move through, its s curves wide open for a long read.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Offside draws every line with an unvarying weight, spaced wide, its curves left open at the ends. But Noto Sans Lydian brings capitals barely above its lowercase, so the text feels low and friendly beneath.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Offside stretches its letters wide with curves that never quite close, all drawn with one fixed nib width. And Noto Sans Mahajani runs tall in the lowercase with a funnel-wide e, so a long passage reads smoothly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Noto Sans Malayalam fills the middle of each line with generous s openings. Offside, meanwhile, is a flat gray hum of constant line weight, and its quiet wide spacing is what makes the pair distinctive.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Offside has a pipe-cleaner feel in every letterform, with wide spacing and curves left open. Yet Noto Sans Mandaic, a plain sans with curvy, unclamped letters, gives the pair its strongest quality: a loose, bending ease.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Offside gives diagonals the same heft as its stems, with wide tracking and curves that stay open. And Noto Sans Marchen, a plain sans with proud, almost capital-sized small letters, meets it with clear daylight at every curve end.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numera: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals shows a gaping c at any size. Offside is sketched as if with a pencil that never presses harder, so its wide, level lettering sits above that tall-bodied plain sans like a quiet header.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads tall in the lowercase, with curves that turn in without ink pooling anywhere. Offside is the one for commanding wide display lines; this body is for steady reading.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Offside holds the line weight of a technical drawing pen, wide-spaced, with curves that refuse to close. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek follows with large lowercase eyes and cracked-bangle rounds, a text that reads loose and open.
